% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): an axis inside a shifted scope, a
% path after the scope at the picture origin.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{scope}[shift={(3cm,2cm)}]
\begin{axis}[width=7cm, height=5cm]
\addplot coordinates {(1,1) (2,4) (3,9) (4,16)};
\end{axis}
\end{scope}
\draw (0,0) -- (1,0);
\end{tikzpicture}
